blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump will attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-US Special Summit in Manila on Nov. 17, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) confirmed on Wednesday as it announced the schedule of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. The three-day gathering, set for Nov. 15 to 18 at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City, will bring together Southeast Asian leaders and dialogue partners to discuss regional and global challenges. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will chair the summit, which opens on Sunday, with plenary and retreat sessions focusing on Asean’s priorities, including […]...
